operating_notes.text: A contractual-workers' strike from 9 May 2026 stopped one coating line at the Dhodsar, Rajasthan plant; the company estimated lost production at about 15,000 linear metres per day.
FY26 standalone other income was ₹54.48 Cr, 5.8% of revenue, against ₹39.66 Cr in FY25.
FY26 standalone operating cash inflow was ₹143.39 Cr against PAT of ₹202.97 Cr, with ₹46.92 Cr absorbed by receivables and ₹27.06 Cr by inventories.
Auto exports for FY26 reached ₹290 Cr compared to ₹194 Cr in FY25.

timeline.summary: On 10 May 2026, Mayur Uniquoters said a contractual-workers' strike from 9 May 2026 had stopped production on one coating line at its Dhodsar, Rajasthan plant, with an estimated loss of about 15,000 linear metres a day.
On 19 May 2026; with Q4FY26 PAT of ₹60.71 Cr; and recommended a ₹6 per share final dividend.
Mayur Uniquoters Ltd shared the audio recording link for its Earnings Conference call on May 20, 2026, for Q4 FY2026 results.
On 1 April 2026, Mayur Uniquoters promoters submitted their annual Regulation 31(4) disclosure confirming zero encumbrance on their 58.77% stake for FY26.
On 23 May 2026, Mayur Uniquoters reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹273.35 Cr and PAT of ₹59.43 Cr.
